decisions_to_carry.decision: Identity revocation SLA: Entra deactivating a person ends access within one minute (P3 exit criterion); revoked session fails on the next request (session cookie cache disabled); authority cache max 30 s with explicit invalidation.

decisions_to_carry.decision: Public product host is https://taskdesk.bimats.com (company domain bimats.com); taskdesk.app is not TaskDesk's domain and UAT must not be inferred from uat.taskdesk.app.

Portal uses host-root URLs (/, /sign-in, /new, /requests/{ref}) with /portal/* redirecting; /agent/* is the single agent app with /dashboard/* redirects; screens without a backend API are hidden, no mock UI ships.

decisions_to_carry.decision: Feature-flag defaults: every enumerated feature seeded off except feature.scim and feature.import (import on and locked at instance level); intake and approvals default off until an admin enables them; disabled feature APIs return generic 404 and navigation hides them; flags never grant permissions; disabling approvals keeps existing approvals readable/decidable and never bypasses workflow approval requirements.
decisions_to_carry.source: archive/2026-10-22/docs/07-planning/decision-log.md:382; archive/2026-10-22/docs/07-planning/decision-log.md:1297 (features.md 'Feature controls' states no defaults; detail in technical/feature-contracts-p3.md)

decisions_to_carry.decision: Engine boundary: if two implementations could be installed side by side and swapped by an admin it is a plugin; otherwise a domain module plus feature flag. Every feature still needs contract, generated configuration, flag and validate/test affordance; nothing hardcoded per customer.

Customer authority matrix is enforced in packages/domain independent of capabilities so the role editor cannot misconfigure it: no assignment, no de-escalation (403), no self-approval, no SLA internals beyond own due time, cannot change own email/organisation/role, cannot delete anything; withdraw only before triage; customer may reopen only an auto-declined submission (staff decline is final).
decisions_to_carry.source: archive/2026-10-22/docs/03-features/customer-portal.md:55; archive/2026-10-22/docs/07-planning/decision-log.md:3149 (features.md P3 mentions escalation-only/withdrawal/reopen only; full matrix in technical/feature-contracts-p3.md)

decisions_to_carry.decision: Customer sign-in scope for this release: email-then-password for already-admitted customers only; registration, invitation acceptance and typed-domain SSO stay closed until the CP-11/CP-12 admission adapter and CP-18/IP-29 discovery route contracts are specified.

risks.risk: Inherited Kaneo calendar/Gantt/timeline, basic time entries and the workflow-rule automation engine were to ship flag-gated OFF until their v2 specs were aligned; current roadmap requires Calendar/Gantt continuity in P1 and says nothing about the inherited automation/time-entry code, so unspecified inherited behavior may become reachable.
risks.source: archive/2026-10-22/docs/07-planning/phases.md:330; archive/2026-10-22/docs/07-planning/phases.md:357; archive/2026-10-22/docs/07-planning/decision-log.md:6954 (contradiction with docs/features.md:26 and docs/roadmap.md P1 row)

risks.risk: Legacy task -> work_item data move may be one-shot only if no live deployment runs the pre-move schema; SIT now holds seeded/real data, so retiring the task stack/tables without a re-check could lose comments, labels, time entries, relations and attachments keyed by task_id.
Workspace ownership transfer was shipped session-only and owner-only with an explicitly recorded step-up debt: it must become elevated (step-up) once step-up exists; no current doc records the debt.

Point-in-time recovery (WAL archiving) was a decision with a deadline 'before real customer data lands' because it fixes the achievable RPO; current docs only recommend it, and roadmap/features never list it as a gate.

Unresolved product questions not listed in alignment.md's 'unresolved details': mention notifications on comment edit; SLA completion/manual-resume pause continuity (D1); CAB membership (team.is_cab) blocking approval:decide_cab; custom_field_type_visibility/custom_field_value tenant anchoring; intake required-file and custom-field mappings held.
